_comment: The opening film's voice-over. Separate from script-keuken.json because it belongs to no room — VoiceBank loads every bundled script-*.json, so a new room or scene is a new file here rather than an edit to an existing one. Same format, same rules.
_generated: 2026-08-15 — rewritten and regenerated to fill the shots

_timing._comment: One line per shot, written to the length of that shot. Measured, not guessed: Gracie delivers Dutch at roughly 15-17 characters a second, so a line's character count predicts its duration to within a few tenths. Re-cut a shot and the line to match it — the numbers below are the working budget.
_timing._note: Both lines were rewritten longer and regenerated on 2026-08-15. They used to total 10.60s under 14.08s of film, which left the last third of each shot silent and made the film look like it was buffering; they now total 13.33s and each ends about two tenths before its own cut. The long pause that used to sit before the cut went with them — it was carrying 'kom je mee naar binnen?' as a question the cut answered, which is still true, except the question is now the last thing in the shot. Video lengths are measured from the mvhd atoms; voice lengths are measured back off the delivered mp3s.

_line_ids._comment: One variant each on purpose: an opening should sound the same every time, the way a title card does. The film is silent, so this is all she hears. nina.intro.keuken fires on the cut between shots rather than on a timer.
_line_ids.nina.intro.buiten: Over the exterior shot. Nina names her own bakery and introduces herself as the baker.
_line_ids.nina.intro.keuken: Over the interior shot, from the cut.

variants.text: Welkom in mijn toverbakkerij! Ik ben Nina, de bakker. Hier maak ik de allermooiste tovertaarten. Kom je mee naar binnen?
Dit is mijn keuken. Hier bakken we de allerlekkerste tovertaarten. Zullen we samen beginnen?
